answer.text: The manual says the hazard lights keep working for 30 minutes, unless they are switched off manually.

policy.text: The hazard flasher cannot be activated with the ignition switched off.

watchouts.text: Hazard flashing strains the battery, so do not use the hazard warning for longer than necessary.

disclaimers.text: The manual does not say whether the 30-minute period continues after the ignition is switched off.
